mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing tamoxifen metabolism and reducing active metabolite (endoxifen) formation, thereby decreasing tamoxifen efficacy in breast cancer treatment.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if St. John's wort is necessary, monitor closely for reduced tamoxifen efficacy and consider alternative antidepressants without enzyme-inducing properties.
